text: Almost scentfree. The candles are pretty, but hardly scented at all.

product_metadata.title: Biedermann & Sons Candy Cane Striped Peppermint Scented Votive Candles, Box of 6
features: Traditional red and white candy cane stripe design
description: Candles are a popular and appealing home accessory -- providing flattering light, evocative fragrance and generally setting a relaxing, festive or romantic mood. Most famous for their Yule Chime, or Christmas Tree, candles, Biedermann & Sons offers a wide range of candle shapes and colors. More than just candles, Biedermann & Sons has also offered a range of giftware and decorative accessories since 1956 when Carl Biedermann forged a relationship with a family-owned business, a German candle-maker and a maker of beautiful handmade angel figures.
